description: Bâtiments patrimoniaux - Ville de Shawinigan is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Shawinigan. Couche polygonale de l'inventaire du patrimoine bâti sur le territoire de la ville de Shawinigan. Logo de Shawinigan Contexte de collecte Inventaire réalisé par la firme PatriArch en 2010, 2014, 2021. Méthode de collecte Localisation à l'adresse, sur le bâtiment. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Shawinigan. Its tags are Batiment patrimonial, Culture, Donnee ouverte, Histoire, Patrimoine. It offers 1 resource(s) in GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-04-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
